key_components: movements_list - List view with filtering and pagination
create_movement - AJAX POST handler for creating stock movements

patterns_discovered.description: Uses select_related() to fetch related objects in single query, preventing N+1 queries
patterns_discovered.benefit: Improved database performance for list views

patterns_discovered.description: Implements flexible search across multiple fields using Q objects
patterns_discovered.benefit: User-friendly search across material code, name, documents, and batch numbers

patterns_discovered.description: Try-catch wrapper around date string parsing to handle invalid formats gracefully
patterns_discovered.code_example: try: date_from = datetime.strptime(date_from, '%Y-%m-%d').date() except ValueError: pass
patterns_discovered.benefit: Prevents crashes from malformed date inputs in filters

patterns_discovered.description: Uses @login_required decorator for access control at function level
patterns_discovered.benefit: Ensures only authenticated users can access movement operations

patterns_discovered.description: Returns JsonResponse with success flag and descriptive messages for client-side handling
patterns_discovered.benefit: Structured responses enable proper client-side error handling and UX feedback

patterns_discovered.description: Checks available inventory before allowing outbound movements
patterns_discovered.benefit: Prevents inventory from going negative or exceeding available stock

patterns_discovered.description: Uses Decimal instead of float for quantity and unit_cost fields
patterns_discovered.benefit: Prevents floating-point precision errors in financial calculations

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Date string variable reuse in context
gotchas_discovered.description: Variables 'date_from' and 'date_to' are reassigned from string to datetime.date objects. If view rendering or form re-rendering occurs, context will have date objects instead of original strings, potentially breaking form value displays.
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Use separate variables like 'date_from_obj' and 'date_from_str' to maintain original string values for context

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Potential N+1 query without select_related for filtered materials
gotchas_discovered.description: Line 71 fetches all active materials without select_related, but materials list is displayed separately from movements. If materials have related objects accessed in template, this could cause additional queries.
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Analyze template usage; consider using prefetch_related if materials have accessed relations

gotchas_discovered.description: unit_cost is optional (can be None) but doesn't validate decimal conversion. If non-numeric string is provided, Decimal() will raise InvalidOperation exception caught only by generic Exception handler.
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Add explicit try-catch for Decimal conversion or add unit_cost to required fields validation

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: No transaction handling for stock movement creation
gotchas_discovered.description: StockMovement is created without updating MaterialStock in atomic transaction. If MaterialStock update happens elsewhere, inconsistency is possible if that operation fails.
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Wrap create_movement operation in database transaction using @transaction.atomic decorator

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Destination warehouse not validated in create_movement
gotchas_discovered.description: select_related includes 'destination_warehouse' but create_movement never sets or validates this field, suggesting incomplete implementation for transfer movements.
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Add destination_warehouse handling for TRANSFER movement type or remove from select_related

gotchas_discovered.description: Lines 149-151 catch all exceptions with generic handler, hiding validation errors, database errors, and programming errors under same 'Erro ao criar movimentação' message.
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions (ValidationError, IntegrityError, etc.) with appropriate user-facing messages

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully created movement_views.py module with two complete views for inventory stock movement management
approach_outcome.test_coverage_notes: No visible test coverage in this file; recommend adding tests for filter combinations and validation edge cases
approach_outcome.documentation: Views have docstrings in Portuguese; could benefit from detailed docstrings explaining parameters and response formats

recommendations.recommendation: Add @transaction.atomic decorator to create_movement to ensure stock updates are atomic with movement creation
recommendations.rationale: Prevents database inconsistencies if stock updates fail after movement is created

recommendations.recommendation: Replace generic Exception handler with specific exception catching (ValidationError, IntegrityError, Decimal InvalidOperation)
recommendations.rationale: Provides better debugging information and allows appropriate user-facing error messages

recommendations.recommendation: Separate date string variables from date object variables in movements_list to maintain original strings for form re-population
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation will break date filter form values on re-render

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit validation and error handling for unit_cost Decimal conversion
recommendations.rationale: Non-numeric input will cause unhandled exception in Decimal() constructor

recommendations.recommendation: Implement destination_warehouse handling for transfer movements or remove from select_related if not used
recommendations.rationale: Currently selected but not used in create_movement logic

recommendations.recommendation: Add comprehensive docstrings with parameter descriptions and return value documentation
recommendations.rationale: Improves code maintainability and API clarity for other developers

recommendations.recommendation: Add unit tests covering filter combinations, validation edge cases, and insufficient stock scenarios
recommendations.rationale: Ensures reliability of critical inventory operations

recommendations.recommendation: Consider caching warehouse and material lists if accessed frequently
recommendations.rationale: These are fetched on every list view request regardless of filtering needs
